lead.zh: 由宿主驱动的四图生成界面。

rule.en: The host performs generation, upscale and download. Respond to each ticket independently and cancel work when asked. The preview uses local simulated data.
rule.zh: 宿主负责生成、放大和下载；按 ticket 分别返回结果，并在收到取消事件时中止工作。预览使用本地模拟数据。

api.en: Call set_progress, finish or fail with the ticket. Stale results after Stop are ignored. A failed or stopped variation keeps its original, and a failure can be retried or restored. Each completed image uses its own reported dimensions. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter starts a batch; plain Enter inserts a newline.
api.zh: 使用 ticket 调用 set_progress、finish 或 fail；停止后的旧结果会被忽略。变体失败或停止保留原图，失败后可重试或恢复；每张完成图片按其报告的尺寸显示比例。Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 开始一批生成，普通回车换行。

motion.en: Progress follows host updates with a 200 ms transition. The pixel mosaic, upscale sweep and full visual comparison are not yet implemented or verified.
motion.zh: 进度以 200ms 过渡跟随宿主更新；像素马赛克、放大扫光及完整视觉对照尚未实现或验收。
